    colors=[v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,1)]

prog='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 1)}
    color = next(iter(colors))
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color]
    min_r = min(r for r, c in points)
    max_r = max(r for r, c in points)
    min_c = min(c for r, c in points)
    max_c = max(c for r, c in points)
    shape = {(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in points}
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    shape_h, shape_w = max_r - min_r + 1, max_c - min_c + 1
    for dr in range(h - shape_h + 1):
        for dc in range(w - shape_w + 1):
            cells = [(dr + r, dc + c) for r, c in shape]
            if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r, c in cells):
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
